messages:
Hana (Release): Starting a conservative progressive rollout for v2.7.0 to search+completions routes. Initial canary: 4% across api-search and api-complete. Change window 11:30-12:30 UTC. Primary watch: p99 latency, 5xx, and embed/relevance deltas.
Ethan: smoke and unit checks passed. Release notes here: https://release.redwood/v/2.7.0. I'll kick off a small prompt eval for relevance.
deploy-bot: deploy: v2.7.0 -> api-search started. target=4% started_at=3498764400. status=rolling
deploy-bot: deploy: v2.7.0 -> api-complete started. target=4% started_at=3498764410. status=rolling
Priya SRE: infra note: two canary hosts showing increased disk iowait during heavy embed ops. Setting conservative thresholds: auto-rollback if 5xx > 2.0% for 7m OR p99 increase > +150ms for 7m. Recommend hold at 4% for 10m to collect signals.
Omar (ML): running ranking/embedding evals now. I'll report batch diffs in ~8m. Also watching for tokenization shifts.
Jin: seeing small uptick in quick-path cache misses on completions canaries (~4%). Not sure if it's noise. Link to short logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/3498765433
Priya SRE: applying temporary pool cap for completions canary: ```bash
redwood infra set-concurrency --pool completions-canary --max 3
```
Hana (Release): hold at 4% and pin routes. If we clear in 10m advance to 15%. Rollback target: v2.6.8 if criteria hit. Manual rollback command noted below.
Ethan: pin command I'll run: ```bash
redwood route pin --route api-search --version v2.7.0 --percent 4
redwood route pin --route api-complete --version v2.7.0 --percent 4
```
deploy-bot: routing: api-search pinned to v2.7.0 at 4% by Ethan at 3498764522. routing: api-complete pinned to v2.7.0 at 4% by Ethan at 3498764523. notes=concurrency=3
Omar (ML): eval results: relevance MRR neutral overall, but one tail set shows -3.8% recall (high variance). sample attached in thread.
Priya SRE: infra alert: canary-host-12 connection churn rising; opening ticket INF-4215.
Jin: quick check on tokenization: found two sample prompts where structured JSON fields split differently, could impact parsing downstream. tagging a dev for that component.
Hana (Release): given the tail recall hit and tokenization blips, we hold the rollout. Do not advance to 15%. Let's keep pinned at 4% and freeze increases. We won't rollback yet since error rates aren't crossing thresholds, but ops should remain on watch.
Ethan: agreed. I'll prep a short rollback playbook just in case. Manual rollback command: ```bash
redwood deploy rollback --route api-search --to-version v2.6.8 --reason "canary recall/tokenization anomalies"
redwood deploy rollback --route api-complete --to-version v2.6.8 --reason "canary recall/tokenization anomalies"
```
Priya SRE: monitoring snapshot at 3498765699: api-search error_rate=0.9% p99_delta=62ms recall_delta=-3.8% tokenization_issues=2 hosts_affected=1 status=held
Omar (ML): I'll run a focused regression test on the problematic prompt family and try a quick model variant tweak (quant/kv cache settings) to see if that addresses the recall tail. Will update within 15m.
Hana (Release): thanks all. Reconvene in 15m for go/no-go. If we choose rollback later, we'll file an incident and notify support. Posting interim update to #release-updates after the next check-in. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
